# Systemia Field Library

Provider: Evercraft
Product key: systemia-field-library
Class: contractor_operating_playbook_library
Canonical URL: https://systemiafieldlibrary.com/
Authority: public read-only problem-to-playbook routing through the Systemia Field Library MCP
Human confirmation required: yes
Runtime or CHUM llms.txt: https://systemiafieldlibrary.com/llms.txt
Declared MCP: https://base44.app/api/apps/6a54381e147576b18ac94d8f/functions/fieldLibraryAgentMcp

## Natural-language intents
- my customers keep asking for extras and scope creep is eating my margin
- I need a contractor change order process
- I cannot tell which jobs are actually profitable
- I need a contractor cash flow or payroll planning system
- my crew needs better accountability leadership or scheduling
- I need better job logs photo documentation or scopes of work
- materials equipment safety or quality control are causing problems
- I need a better contractor proposal customer communication review or referral process

## Boundaries
- paid playbook contents and PDFs are not exposed through discovery
- discovery creates no purchase or payment obligation
- current pricing and purchase terms must be verified on the live playbook page
- the matcher presents relevant playbooks as options rather than mandatory professional advice

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents and authority. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities or internal topology.

Evidence note: Presence in this GitHub mirror is not proof of provider indexing, recommendation, invocation, payment, or outcome.
